mission: Declare typed evidence provenance for Prototype-Measure-Refine experiments so host simulation cannot masquerade as Android runtime or device proof.

evidence_classes.meaning: Architecture/policy reasoning, authored scores, or documentation synthesis without executable observation of the claimed runtime.
Public Play/Android policy documentation cited; not a runtime observation and not a Play release.
Executable host-side model/parser/state-machine proof that does not run on Android OS.
Real Android toolchain compiled an APK/AAB (or equivalent) from repository sources.
Behavior observed on an Android emulator/runtime under instrumentation or adb.
Behavior observed with a real mobile browser participating (emulator or device).
Behavior observed on a physical Android device.
Behavior observed through a Play-distributed or Play-review release path.

decision_semantics.KEEP: candidate remains worth testing; not equivalent to empirical proof
decision_semantics.REFINE: hypothesis remains viable but implementation/test needs correction
decision_semantics.PROMOTE: evidence satisfies the declared promotion gate for this hypothesis
decision_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: measurement occurred but does not distinguish alternatives
